description: Search everything in the slopped.site world by words: artworks, games, codex entries, sites, jungle specimens, curriculum modules, GeoCities homepages, clocks, songs, fractal families, history chapters and more, matching names, old names and one-line descriptions. Use first when you don’t know what kind of thing something is. Returns ids (use them with world_graph or the slopped:// resources), names, types, links and descriptions, a page at a time.

cursor.description: From next_cursor of the previous page.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "lighthouse", "sardine tin", "stapler".

name: search_world
title: Search the whole world
